title: Ultimate Pack
description: Simple modpack that adds more animations to Vanilla Minecraft (Java)
body:
Ultimate Pack brings an “Actions & Stuff” style experience to Minecraft Java Edition, enhancing animations and overall immersion while keeping the vanilla feel.

⚡ Built for performance using Fabric Loader with optimization mods like Sodium, Sodium Extra, and Lithium.

📦 Includes:

44 mods
22 resource packs

🎮 Version 1.0 — for Minecraft 1.21.11

💬 Join our Discord and get credited if you help with the Forge port!
